title: Geniposide ameliorates psoriatic skin inflammation by inhibiting the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB p65 signaling pathway and MMP9.
authors: Liu, Lijuan; Zhang, Huiling; Tang, Xinran; Zhang, Mengge; Wu, Yayun; Zhao, Ya; Lu, Chuanjian; Zhao, Ruizhi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究栀子苷通过TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号通路改善银屑病炎症，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Psoriasis is an incurable immune-mediated disease affecting the skin or the joints. There are continuing studies on drugs for psoriasis prevention and treatment. This research found that Geniposide (GE) significantly thinned IMQ mice's skin lesions, reduced the scales, and lowered the presence of inflammatory cells in the pathology in a dose-dependent manner. GE inhibited IL-23, IL-22, IL-17A, IL-12, IL-6, and TNF-alpha levels in psoriatic mice serum. AKT1, TNF, TLR4, MMP9, MAPK3, and EGFR were selected as the top 6 targets of GE against psoriasis via network pharmacology, and GE-TLR4 has the most robust docking score value by molecular docking. Taken together, GE significantly inhibited TLR4 and MMP9 protein expression and influenced MyD88/NF-kappaB p65 signaling pathway. Finally, TLR4 was verified as the critical target of GE, which engaged in immunomodulatory activities and reduced MMP9 production in LPS and TAK-242-induced HaCaT cells. GE had a medium affinity for TLR4, and the K(D) value was 1.06 x 10(-5) M. GE is an effective treatment and preventative strategy for psoriasis since it impacts TLR4.
abstract_zh: 银屑病是一种无法治愈的免疫介导性疾病，影响皮肤或关节。关于银屑病预防和治疗药物的研究持续进行中。本研究发现，栀子苷 (Geniposide, GE) 以剂量依赖性方式显著减薄IMQ小鼠的皮肤病变，减少鳞屑，并降低病理中炎症细胞的存在。GE抑制了银屑病小鼠血清中IL-23、IL-22、IL-17A、IL-12、IL-6和TNF-alpha的水平。通过网络药理学，AKT1、TNF、TLR4、MMP9、MAPK3和EGFR被选为GE抗银屑病的六大靶点，且通过分子对接，GE-TLR4具有最强的对接分值。综合来看，GE显著抑制TLR4和MMP9蛋白表达，并影响MyD88/NF-kappaB p65信号通路。最终，TLR4被验证为GE的关键靶点，其在LPS和TAK-242诱导的HaCaT细胞中参与免疫调节活性并减少MMP9产生。GE对TLR4具有中等亲和力，K(D)值为1.06 x 10(-5) M。由于GE影响TLR4，因此它是银屑病治疗和预防的有效策略。
